en-GB.name: 4NextBus
en-GB.summary: Live Dublin bus times for any stop, plus a favourite stop you can ask about with one phrase.
en-GB.description:
This skill tells you the next Dublin buses from your chosen bus stop, using the National Transport Authority's real-time data.

Set or change your favourite stop by saying "Alexa, ask 4NextBus to set my favourite stop to 184". Then simply asking "Alexa, ask 4NextBus" gives you your local buses. Get a reminder of your favourite stop by saying "Alexa, ask 4NextBus for my favourite stop". Get buses for any stop by saying "Alexa, ask 4NextBus from stop 184".

The stop number is the number printed on the bus stop pole. Where live information is not available, timetable times are given instead.

Note: this is not an official Dublin Bus or TFI skill. It uses publicly available real-time information provided by the National Transport Authority.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask four next bus from stop 184
Alexa, ask four next bus to set my favourite stop to 184
Alexa, ask four next bus for the next bus

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say: ask four next bus from stop 184. Then: ask four next bus to set my favourite stop to 184. Then: ask four next bus for the next bus.
